additional_info.subject: ID0426308-DC/Si-D/IT[ATAC] - XF4 config CRM:00315002674
additional_info.body:
Ciao guys, good morning.
From our side, there is nothing else we can provide. I would recommend you to go to site and bring a spare router to test if the problem is related to HW.
Unlike the old version, we cannot ascertain if the WAN port is faulty or similar.
There are only 3 things to check:
Ethernet cable to the correct router in the WAN port
Any damage on the cable
Try swapping the cable
Router is faulty
Customer's configurations are not correct or IP is already in use in the network.
Since I am not able to provide more support I will forward this ticket to your queue. As always, if you need support just reach out to me via M.Teams.
Thanks and have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
